name: Move Amplifier - First Strike
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. It can also enhance the capability of an ST's first attack per turn.

61201.name: Movement Enhancement I - First Strike
61201.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
On the <color=#F74848>1st</color> active attack per turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
